page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top with page number 114 at the left and "Q. XII." at the right. Carried-over line at the top of the text, then "Resp." set on its own line, then one paragraph. Catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: secundâ parte libri sui evidenter & solidè demonstravit.
Resp.
Satis explicatum est tùm verbis alio-
rum Orthodoxorum Theologorum, quæ
citavi; nimirùm Pastores non simpliciter pendere à suprema potestate
seu quantum ad genus doctrinæ & Sacramentorum; sed secundùm quid ratione
vocationis, directionis & censuræ, ut Pareus loquitur; seu ut clarius
Dn. Walæus ait: non in partibus essentialibus
circumstantiis administrationis:tum verbis meis
propriis, quando dixi, eos subjectos esse Magistratui non quoad substantiam officii, sed quoad exercitii
directionem, ordinem externum & circumstantias. Et in ipso proœmio rejeci doctrinam Arminianorum, quam Cl.
V. Valqus[?] solidè refutavit in secunda par-
te tractatus sui; nimirum Ministros
pendere à Magistratu, ut delegati pendent â
suis principalibus, quorum servi seu vi-
carii sunt. Summa: Satis indicavi hoc
non esse intelligendum de potestate ipsâ
ordinis & jurisdictionis, quasi eam &
quidem omnem non à Christo immedia-
tè accepissent; sed esse intelligendum de
circumstantiis ministerii in exercitio pot-
estatis illius.

page.notes: The header carries "Q. XII." at the right, which is a quaestio marker and is not part of the running head. "Valqus" is printed with a q-like letter; probably Valæus, but kept as printed and marked [?]. The "â" in "pendent â" and "ipsâ" is printed with a circumflex-like mark, copied as printed.
